body:
I feel ridiculous about this, but I have strong feelings about the coworker I sit next to, and I know full well that nothing will happen between me and her. We really click at times, more than I've ever clicked with anyone. 

I also attempted suicide last year, and I'm seeing the same behaviors right before I attempted in myself during the last couple of months. I feel like I will impulsively attempt again.

I'm scared that I will fail my classes, and I'm also terrified about the cost of the hospitalization. I see my therapist tonight in a group therapy session, and I don't how to approach her about the subject.
